title: Expandable ledger
description: Explain a transaction in place instead of navigating away from the ledger.
useCase: Explain a transaction in place instead of navigating away from the ledger.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Fictional ledger data. Totals and details are for presentation, not financial calculations.
look: Light warm-grey page with a single white rounded card listing expenses: lettered serif avatar tiles, sans names and dates, right-aligned amounts and chevrons.
motion: Clicking a row grows its detail from 0fr to 1fr grid rows over 210 ms ease-out as the chevron turns 90°; opening one row closes the previous one.
adapt: `.ledger-detail` animates `grid-template-rows` (0fr to 1fr, 210ms) when `open` matches the row index, and `.ledger-chevron` rotates alongside. Replace the `rows` array; keep the `data-keyboard` and `data-paused` rules that zero transitions.
